verdict.rationale: Clerky's docs describe inviting multiple people to collaborate on a document set in real time and assigning tasks to co-founders, implying multi-party signing is part of its startup paperwork workflow, but there is no explicit mention of e-signature legality, signing order, or routing configuration akin to a dedicated e-signature product. missing for 10: explicit 'legally binding e-signature' language, description of routing/sequencing logic for multiple signers, and any independent confirmation of the signing UX.
